pages.title: Soul Shards
pages.text: If a familiar dies it does not merely return to the Otherworld. Due to the close connection to the summoner a splinter of the familiar's soul remains in the mortal realm.$(br2)This splinter - shard - can be used to re-summon the $()

pages.title: Resurrection
pages.text: The resurrection is a relatively simple process. The soul shard is strengthened with $(item)Otherworld Essence$() until it is strong enough to allow the familiar to return to the mortal realm and create a new body for itself.$(br2)The essence is $()

pages.title: Resurrection
pages.text: obtained by growing (lots of) Demons Dream plants.$(br)
